name: transcript-crafter v1.0.0
body:
## v1.0.0

### Added
- 10-dimension extraction from interview/meeting transcripts
- 6 writing persona matching system
- 8-step main pipeline with 3 confirmation checkpoints
- 5-tool search supplement (WebSearch, WebFetch, competitor analysis, data verification, background)
- Quality verification checklist
- Anti-AI-tone writing rules
- WeChat Official Account formatting guide
- Dual delivery: local save + Feishu cloud drive sync
